scope: Installed console package React payload bilingual browser smoke over HTTPS

test.title: installed package payload supports bilingual login, gateway status and task history

coverage: Chinese login page title and labels
localized incorrect-password error then English error update
tenant-scoped gateway row with online tag and heartbeat

observedBehavior.encryptedResultContextBinding: Copying a valid encrypted result into controlled task rows with different task IDs made gateway/task list reporting fail closed; clearing those copied results restored normal API behavior. This is correct context binding, not a production defect.

limits: This is a focused package payload live smoke, not replacement of the full existing default browser collection.
Default console/i18n suites remain tied to the separate development-center fixture and were not rerun here.
